title: LemonMatrix Image Generation Benchmark Result
description: A single image-generation benchmark run for one model (Lemonade's sd-cpp/thenoise recipes). Covers three operations sharing one schema since they run through the same model and produce the same metric shape: 'generate' (POST /v1/images/generations, text-to-image), 'edit' (POST /v1/images/edits, prompt-guided edit of an input image), and 'variation' (POST /v1/images/variations, unguided variation of an input image). Deliberately separate from result.schema.json: images/sec is not comparable to LLM token throughput, so image-generation runs are never mixed into the main model/router leaderboard. Image upscale (POST /v1/images/upscale) is deliberately NOT covered here -- confirmed against Lemonade's own server source that it shells out to a CLI subprocess per request rather than going through the normal load/Router path, so it has no persistent model residency to verify exclusivity or reload-freedom against.

run_id.description: Unique identifier for this run (UUID recommended).

timestamp.description: UTC timestamp when the run started.

name.description: Model id as registered in Lemonade, e.g. SD-Turbo.

checkpoint.description: Underlying HF checkpoint, if known, e.g. owner/repo.

config.description: The matrix axes for this run.

power_cap_w.description: Applied power cap in watts, if power_state is power_capped.

environment.description: Fingerprint of the machine and software stack. Auto-discovered from the profile. Required for any run to be comparable.

igpu_family.description: AMD GPU ROCm architecture codename, e.g. gfx1151.

dgpu_family.description: AMD GPU ROCm architecture codename, e.g. gfx950 -- confirmed more reliable than name for at least one real datacenter card whose name field was a bare numeric string.

backend_version.description: Version of the underlying image-gen engine build, if Lemonade reports it as installed.

metrics.description: Generation latency and throughput at a fixed size -- materially changes generation cost, so required for reproducibility. The response carries no timing field, so generation time is measured client-side as wall-clock time around the request -- this times the network round trip to whatever machine the profile actually points at, not local hardware. steps/cfg_scale/seed are only meaningful for 'generate'/'edit' -- Lemonade's own /v1/images/variations does not accept them at all (confirmed against its server source), so they are optional rather than required.

generation_time_ms.description: Mean wall-clock time to generate one image (n=1).

trial_count.description: Number of measured (non-warmup) trials included in aggregated metrics.

operation.description: Which of Lemonade's three image endpoints this run measured -- a genuinely different compute path per operation, so required for reproducibility.

steps.description: Diffusion step count. Materially affects generation time. Not applicable to 'variation'.

cfg_scale.description: Classifier-free-guidance scale passed on the request, if any. Not applicable to 'variation'.

seed.description: Seed passed on the request, if any. Not applicable to 'variation'.

prompt_chars.description: Character length of the prompt used for every trial. Not applicable to 'variation' (no prompt).

has_mask.description: True if an edit mask was supplied. Only applicable to 'edit'.

validity.description: Confounder controls. A run that fails a gate must set valid=false and record why.

valid.description: False if any hard gate failed. Invalid runs are shown but never ranked.

warmup_discarded.description: True if warmup iterations were excluded from timing.

exclusive_run.description: True if no competing model workload ran during measurement, per server-verified /api/v1/health polling where possible.

model_reload_free.description: True if the model stayed resident for the whole run (no reload tax).

notes.description: Any flags, caveats, or reasons a gate failed.
